deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Online Store" > "Themes" > "Actions" > "Edit code". Select the "templates" folder and open the "returns.liquid" file in a text editor.

Add the following code to the "returns.liquid" file to embed the returns reason capture form: `<form id="returns-reason-form"> <label for="reason">Reason for return:</label> <select id="reason" name="reason"> <option value="defective">Defective</option> <option value="not-as-described">Not as described</option> <option value="change-of-mind">Change of mind</option> <option value="other">Other (please specify)</option> </select> <input type="text" id="other-reason" name="other-reason" placeholder="Please specify" style="display:none;"> <button type="submit">Submit</button> </form>`,

Save the changes to the "returns.liquid" file and click "Save". Go to "Settings" > "Checkout" and select the "Return policy" tab. Under "Return reason", select "Custom" and enter the ID of the "returns-reason-form" form. Click "Save".

Test the returns flow by initiating a return from the customer's account. The returns reason capture form should be displayed on the returns page, allowing customers to select a reason for return or enter a custom reason.
